title: Privacy policy
intro: This policy explains what information this website collects, why we collect it and how we look after it. We never sell your information.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body:
When you send a request through our website, we collect the details you give us: your name, phone number, email address, the design you're interested in, your cemetery, your timeline and any message you include.

Like most websites, our hosting and security services also record basic technical information, such as your IP address and browser type, to keep the site running and protect it from spam.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body:
* To respond to your request and answer your questions
* To prepare quotes and design proofs
* To keep the website secure and working well

sections.heading: Who we share it with
sections.body:
We use a small number of trusted service providers to run this website and receive your requests, including Google (which stores form submissions) and Cloudflare (which protects the form from spam). They process information only on our behalf.

We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: This website does not use advertising cookies or analytics tracking. Our spam protection may use a cookie or similar technology to tell people apart from automated bots. If we add analytics in the future, we'll update this policy.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep request details for as long as we need them to help you and to keep a record of your order. You can ask us to delete them at any time.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can ask us to update or delete the information you've sent us by calling or writing to us using the details below.
